title: Signed copy of Alien Conspiracy

tellings.quote: lo and behold, on the first page, it was signed [music] by Chris Evans, dated December 1st, 2004.

plain: Jesse Michels says he got hold of a copy of a book called Alien Conspiracy and found, on its first page, a signature from a man named Chris Evans, dated December 1, 2004. Michels tells it himself, as something he found, and brings it up as a clue linking Evans to the story of crashed craft and bodies that his episode is about.
